events.name: Wayanad Landslide
events.description: Catastrophic landslide at Mundakkai-Chooralmala villages, Wayanad, Kerala. Triggered by 572mm rainfall in 24 hours. Deadliest landslide in Kerala's history.

events.name: Cyclone Dana
events.description: Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Dana made landfall near Bhitarkanika, Odisha. Wind speed 100-110 kmph. 5.84 lakh people evacuated across Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.

events.name: Joshimath Land Subsidence
events.description: Rapid land subsidence in Joshimath, Uttarakhand. ISRO satellite data recorded 5.4cm subsidence in 12 days. 868 houses cracked. NTPC Tapovan-Vishnugad hydropower tunnel construction linked as contributing factor.

events.name: Delhi Yamuna Floods
events.description: Yamuna river breached all-time high of 208.65m in Delhi, surpassing 1978 record of 207.49m. 27,000+ people evacuated. Heavy rains plus Haryana dam release blamed.

events.name: Manipur Ethnic Violence
events.description: Ethnic conflict between Meitei and Kuki-Zo communities triggered by Meitei ST status demand. 200+ deaths, 70,000+ displaced. 143-day internet shutdown. Army and CRPF deployed.

events.name: Tata Semiconductor Fab
events.description: Cabinet approved India's first advanced semiconductor fab. Tata Electronics + Powerchip: ₹91,000 crore plant at Dholera, Gujarat. CG Power + Renesas: ₹7,600 crore at Sanand, Gujarat. Under India Semiconductor Mission.

events.name: Chandrayaan-3 Moon Landing
events.description: India's Chandrayaan-3 Vikram lander soft-landed on the lunar south pole, making India the first nation to land near the lunar south pole and the fourth globally to achieve a soft Moon landing. Pragyan rover operated for 14 days before entering sleep mode.

events.name: Aditya-L1 Solar Mission
events.description: ISRO launched India's first solar observatory Aditya-L1 from Sriharikota. Spacecraft inserted into L1 Lagrange-point halo orbit on 6 Jan 2024. Carries 7 payloads including VELC coronagraph for continuous solar observation.

events.name: G20 New Delhi Summit
events.description: India hosted the G20 Leaders' Summit under its Presidency theme 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam'. Historic consensus New Delhi Declaration on Ukraine, global debt restructuring, AI governance and sustainable development. African Union admitted as permanent G20 member.

events.name: India-Canada Diplomatic Row
events.description: Canadian PM Trudeau alleged Indian government involvement in killing of Khalistani separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in British Columbia. India expelled Canadian diplomat, suspended visa services, and rejected allegations. Bilateral relations severely strained through 2024.

events.name: IMEC Corridor Signing
events.description: India, USA, UAE, Saudi Arabia, EU, France, Germany and Italy signed MoU for India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) at G20 sidelines. Rail-and-shipping route connecting India to Europe via Gulf, positioning India as a key global trade hub.

events.name: Iran-US-Israel War
events.description: US and Israel launched airstrikes on Iran on Feb 28 2026, killing Supreme Leader Khamenei. Iran blockaded Strait of Hormuz. Ceasefire talks ongoing via Pakistan, Oman, Turkey mediators.

events.name: Twelve-Day War (Israel-Iran)
events.description: Israel launched strikes on Iran nuclear and military infrastructure June 13-24 2025. Ceasefire after 12 days. Triggered first major oil price spike of 2025; strained India Chabahar port access.

events.name: India Extreme Weather Year 2025
events.description: India recorded extreme weather events on 331 of 334 days in 2025 — 4,419 deaths, 11M hectares of crop damage across 23 states. Deadliest year for climate-related disasters.

events.name: India-UK Trade Agreement (CETA)
events.description: India and UK signed CETA in London — 99% tariff elimination on Indian exports, targeting 20B bilateral trade by 2030. India most significant bilateral FTA in decades.

events.name: S&P Sovereign Rating Upgrade (BBB)
events.description: S&P upgraded India's sovereign credit rating from BBB- to BBB — first upgrade in 18 years. Signals surge in FII inflows and lower sovereign borrowing costs.

events.name: Four Labour Codes Enforcement
events.description: India enforced all four Labour Codes replacing 29 existing laws — most significant structural labour reform since 1991. Affects 500M+ workforce across all 36 states and UTs.

events.name: ISRO SpaDeX Satellite Docking
events.description: ISRO achieved in-orbit satellite docking under SpaDeX mission, making India only the 4th nation globally (after USA, Russia, China) with this capability. Power transfer also achieved April 2025.

events.name: First Indian on ISS — Shubhanshu Shukla
events.description: Gp Capt Shubhanshu Shukla became first Indian on ISS via Axiom-4 mission, spending 18 days conducting microgravity experiments. Precursor to Gaganyaan space station programme.

events.name: India-US 10-Year Defence Partnership Framework
events.description: India and US signed 10-year Major Defence Partnership Framework covering technology co-production, industrial collaboration, and Indo-Pacific security integration. Strategic leap beyond procurement.

events.name: Pahalgam Terror Attack
events.description: 26 civilians killed by TRF/LeT militants in Baisaran Valley, Pahalgam, J&K — deadliest attack on civilians since 2008 Mumbai. India suspended Indus Waters Treaty, trade, and visas with Pakistan next day.

events.name: Operation Sindoor
events.description: India launched tri-service precision strikes on 9 LeT/JeM terror sites in Pakistan and PoJK (01:05-01:28 AM IST, 23 minutes). Pakistan retaliated with LoC shelling and drones. Ceasefire reached May 10.

events.name: India-Pakistan LoC Skirmishes
events.description: 12 consecutive nights of unprovoked cross-LoC firing by Pakistan Army at Kupwara, Uri, Poonch, Rajouri, Akhnoor, Baramulla. First drone battle between two nuclear-armed states (May 8-9). ~16 Indian civilians killed in Poonch.

events.name: India-Pakistan Ceasefire
events.description: India and Pakistan announced ceasefire effective 5 PM IST May 10. Violations reported same evening. Broadly held militarily. Indus Waters Treaty, trade suspension, and diplomatic downgrade remain in place.

events.name: India-Pakistan Diplomatic Crisis
events.description: Deepest India-Pakistan diplomatic downgrade since 1971 — mutual diplomat expulsions, high commission staff cut from 55 to 30, trade suspended, Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance. IWT still suspended as of Mar 2026.

events.name: Indus Waters Treaty Suspension
events.description: India suspended the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty citing cross-border terrorism after Pahalgam. Pakistan called it weaponization of water. World Bank stated no unilateral suspension clause. International court confirmed jurisdiction Aug 2025. Still in abeyance Mar 2026.

events.name: Strait of Hormuz Blockade
events.description: Iran blockaded Strait of Hormuz following US-Israel airstrikes — Brent crude spiked to 20/barrel. 28 Indian ships with ~800 seafarers stranded. India imports 85% of oil through this route. PM Modi activated emergency energy diplomacy.

events.name: Iran War Ceasefire Negotiations
events.description: Iran rejected US 15-point ceasefire proposal as maximalist. Mediators Pakistan, Oman, Turkey, Egypt engaged in backchannel talks. No ceasefire as of Mar 26, 2026. India called for de-escalation to restore Hormuz shipping.
